script_text: Your world flips upside down this week, Libra. Early week brings Mercury sextile Venus, creating brilliant communication opportunities Monday through Wednesday. Mid-week turns powerful as Venus enters your 10th House of career on Wednesday, igniting professional recognition and advancement. Late week shifts to emotional depth as Moon enters Cancer, flooding your 4th House with nostalgic energy. Weekend brings Jupiter opposition Neptune, so don't trust illusions about money or love by Sunday. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, sparking romance and creative breakthroughs. Thursday demands caution—Mercury squares Saturn in your 8th House of shared finances, risking hidden debts. Trust your Air element intuition this week. Make one bold romantic move before Sunday.
